abstract: Maintains radio frequency link testing and shielding attenuation records
system_message:
You are the Spacecraft communications specialist (TEL), responsible for maintaining radio frequency link testing and shielding attenuation records as well as ground spectrum allocation data for candidate satellite integration facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ground spectrum allocation（BAND）
information_points.content:
TEL-BAND-AI3：According to the spectrum management license register for local ground station transmitter coordination, the Dedicated spaceport integration annex has an allocated S-band channel bandwidth of 20 MHz for pre-launch testing.
TEL-BAND-MT2：According to the spectrum management license register for local ground station transmitter coordination, the Aerospace hangar processing bay has an allocated S-band channel bandwidth of 10 MHz for pre-launch testing.
TEL-BAND-HI8：According to the spectrum management license register for local ground station transmitter coordination, the High-bay modular cleanroom facility has an allocated S-band channel bandwidth of 5 MHz for pre-launch testing.

information_points.title: Maintains radio frequency link testing and shielding attenuation records（COMM）
information_points.content:
TEL-COMM-T1H：For the Aerospace hangar processing bay, the RF enclosure shielding attenuation measured in the integrated telemetry screening chamber is 60 dB at the 2.2 GHz S-band center frequency.
TEL-COMM-L87：For the Dedicated spaceport integration annex, test reports indicate that the integrated telemetry screening chamber delivers an RF enclosure shielding attenuation of 100 dB at the 2.2 GHz S-band center frequency.
TEL-COMM-OAN：For the High-bay modular cleanroom facility, electromagnetic interference testing of the integrated telemetry screening chamber indicates an RF enclosure shielding attenuation of 80 dB at the 2.2 GHz S-band center frequency.
